booking_request_kind_check.name: booking_request_kind_check
booking_request_kind_check.value:
(
				"booking_request"."kind" = 'booking'
				AND "booking_request"."check_in" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_request"."check_out" IS NOT NULL
				AND "booking_request"."check_out" > "booking_request"."check_in"
				AND "booking_request"."adults" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_request"."adults" >= 1
				AND "booking_request"."children" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_request"."children" >= 0
			) OR (
				"booking_request"."kind" = 'question'
				AND "booking_request"."check_in" IS NULL AND "booking_request"."check_out" IS NULL
				AND "booking_request"."room_id" IS NULL
				AND "booking_request"."adults" IS NULL AND "booking_request"."children" IS NULL
				AND "booking_request"."nightly_rate_minor" IS NULL AND "booking_request"."estimated_total_minor" IS NULL
			)

booking_request_price_check.name: booking_request_price_check
booking_request_price_check.value:
("booking_request"."nightly_rate_minor" IS NULL) = ("booking_request"."estimated_total_minor" IS NULL)
				AND "booking_request"."nightly_rate_minor" >= 0 AND "booking_request"."estimated_total_minor" >= 0

attraction_coordinates_check.name: attraction_coordinates_check
attraction_coordinates_check.value: ("attraction"."latitude" IS NULL) = ("attraction"."longitude" IS NULL) AND "attraction"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "attraction"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180

property_location_coordinates_check.name: property_location_coordinates_check
property_location_coordinates_check.value: ("property_location"."latitude" IS NULL) = ("property_location"."longitude" IS NULL) AND "property_location"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "property_location"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180

media_asset_focal_check.name: media_asset_focal_check
media_asset_focal_check.value: ("media_asset"."focal_x" IS NULL) = ("media_asset"."focal_y" IS NULL) AND "media_asset"."focal_x" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "media_asset"."focal_y" BETWEEN 0 AND 1

media_asset_video_fields_check.name: media_asset_video_fields_check
media_asset_video_fields_check.value: "media_asset"."kind" = 'video' OR ("media_asset"."duration_seconds" IS NULL AND "media_asset"."poster_asset_id" IS NULL)
